interpretation: Recall uses complete fixed pools and corpus-positive denominators. When a compatible fit-side sample is supplied, it includes groups skipped by reranker fitting because no positive was retrieved. The embedding encoder was fitted on fit-side texts. A fit-side/validation gap alone does not prove overfitting. Tune and confirmation texts are separated now, but the historical holdout has previously been inspected.

selection.selection_metric: tune macro Recall@50 over complete pools
selection.confirmation_caveat: Historical validation was previously used for experiments; this is not a new untouched holdout.

fit_side_sample_note: Fit-side sample includes groups skipped by reranker fitting when no positive was retrieved. The embedding encoder was trained on fit-side texts; gaps alone are not proof of reranker overfitting.
train_minus_validation_gap_definition: Legacy field name: overall fit-side sample minus validation Recall, including fit-side groups ineligible for reranker fitting. Not evidence of overfitting by itself.

sampled_training_row_loss.meaning: Binary loss on clicked versus sampled unobserved rows; this is not Recall or relevance accuracy.

training_prior_policy_evidence.caveat: Static frozen producer and fit-cache flags establish the inferred compatibility policy; the original historical training rows were not independently verified.
